project.name: dandori
project.description: Dandori is a meal-planning co-pilot for a few invited Users cooking for themselves: each supermarket Delivery opens a Cycle that an LLM planner fills with batch-cooked Prep Sessions and Portions aimed at the User's nutrition Targets, from their Recipe Library and what the Kitchen Ledger says the kitchen holds, for the User to approve.

nodes.name: Identity & Access
nodes.summary: Lets the few invited Users into Dandori by Supabase magic link and keeps every other page behind a signed-in session. It creates the User row at first sign-in, refreshes sessions from secure cookies and revokes them on sign-out.

businessRules: Only invited emails can sign in; Users are never self-registered
Every page except sign-in, confirm and health is behind the SignedIn middleware
Row-level security lets each User see only their own rows (db.AsUser)
crossDomainInteractions: Hands the signed-in User to Profile & Goals, whose LanguageChosen middleware asks for a Language first

nodes.name: Sign In with Magic Link
nodes.summary: An invited User types their email, receives a Supabase magic link, opens it and confirms; the tokens are redeemed and kept in secure cookies, and the User row is created at first sign-in.

nodes.name: Request magic link
nodes.summary: Reads the typed email and asks the Service to send a link, redirecting to the sent page or showing a send failure.

nodes.name: Send magic link
nodes.summary: Asks Supabase Auth to mail a magic link to an invited email.

nodes.name: Show confirmation
nodes.summary: The emailed link lands on a confirm page so mail scanners can't spend the one-time token.

nodes.name: Confirm link
nodes.summary: Posts the token hash, redeems it and lands on Today, or explains a bad or expired link.

nodes.name: Redeem token
nodes.summary: Verifies the OTP with Supabase and upserts the User row as that User under row-level security.

nodes.name: Set session cookie
nodes.summary: Stores access and refresh tokens in secure, http-only cookies.

nodes.name: Authenticate Request
nodes.summary: Every signed-in route checks the session cookies, validates or refreshes the JWT, and puts the User id on the request context for row-level security.

domainMeta.entryPoint: SignedIn middleware on every signed-in route

nodes.name: Read cookies
nodes.summary: Reads the access and refresh tokens from the request's cookies.

nodes.name: Authenticate
nodes.summary: Validates the access token against Supabase's signing keys, refreshing an expired session.

nodes.name: Guard route
nodes.summary: Redirects to sign-in without a session, rewrites refreshed cookies and carries the User id into the handler.

nodes.name: Sign Out
nodes.summary: Revokes the Supabase session and clears the cookies.

nodes.name: Handle sign-out
nodes.summary: Clears the session cookies and redirects to sign-in.

nodes.name: Revoke session
nodes.summary: Revokes the session's refresh token at Supabase.

nodes.name: Profile & Goals
nodes.summary: Holds each User's lasting settings: the Language their Food Terms are written in, Slot times, daily nutrition Targets, the Meal Out estimate, excluded and allergen foods, owned appliances and the free-text Planning Brief. Each Profile section saves on its own and answers with an htmx self-swap.

businessRules: The Language can change only until the User has written any Food Term (Ingredients, Recipes, Portions)
Targets: kcal within a tolerance (default 5%), protein and fibre floors, a sugar ceiling
Slot times must run breakfast, lunch, snack, dinner in day order; unset times use the code defaults
Changing Targets or the Planning Brief never starts a planning Run nor reopens an approved Plan
Appliances are a fixed list of kinds (ADR-0020), each with a free-text model note
crossDomainInteractions: Feeds Plan Proposals: the planner prompt reads Targets, foods, appliances and the Planning Brief, and a Plan Proposal snapshots its Targets
Opening a Cycle is refused without Targets; Today places Slots by the Slot times

nodes.name: Choose Language
nodes.summary: At first sign-in the User must pick English or Italian; later they may change it on the Profile while no Food Term exists.

nodes.name: Require language
nodes.summary: LanguageChosen middleware sends a User with no Profile to the Language choice.

nodes.name: Show choice
nodes.summary: Renders the first-sign-in Language choice.

nodes.name: Choose
nodes.summary: Reads the posted Language and saves it, creating the Profile row.

nodes.name: Parse language
nodes.summary: Parses en/it codes into a Language.

nodes.name: Check can change
nodes.summary: Allows a change only while no Food Term has been written.

nodes.name: Save language
nodes.summary: Creates or updates the Profile's Language under lock, refusing once Food Terms exist.

nodes.name: Remember cookie
nodes.summary: Saves the Language and remembers it in a cookie for later pages.

nodes.name: Save Targets
nodes.summary: The User sets daily kcal (with tolerance), protein, fibre and sugar Targets the planner aims at.

nodes.name: Submit targets
nodes.summary: Reads the Targets section and re-renders it saved or with field errors.

nodes.name: Parse targets
nodes.summary: Parses each Target as a whole number within bounds, with per-field Problems.

nodes.name: Save targets
nodes.summary: Stores the Targets on the Profile.

nodes.name: Answer refused
nodes.summary: Renders a section with localised field errors and an error summary.

nodes.name: Save Slot Times
nodes.summary: The User sets the time of day of breakfast, lunch, snack and dinner, used by Today and planning.

nodes.name: Submit times
nodes.summary: Reads the four Slot times and re-renders the section.

nodes.name: Parse time
nodes.summary: Parses a typed time 24-hour (Italian) or am/pm (English).

nodes.name: Parse slot times
nodes.summary: Validates the times are in day order.

nodes.name: Save slot times
nodes.summary: Stores the Slot times on the Profile.

nodes.name: Save Meal Out Estimate and Foods
nodes.summary: The User sets the default nutrition of a Meal Out and lists foods to exclude and allergens the planner must avoid.

nodes.name: Submit meal out
nodes.summary: Reads the Meal Out estimate section.

nodes.name: Parse meal out
nodes.summary: Parses each value as a whole number below 10000, fibre and sugar allowed Unknown.

nodes.name: Save meal out
nodes.summary: Stores the Meal Out estimate.

nodes.name: Submit foods
nodes.summary: Reads the excluded foods and allergies.

nodes.name: Normalise foods
nodes.summary: Splits by lines, commas or semicolons into lower-case de-duplicated foods.

nodes.name: Save foods
nodes.summary: Stores exclusions and allergies.

nodes.name: Save Appliances and Planning Brief
nodes.summary: The User ticks the appliances they own (with model notes) and writes the Planning Brief every planning Run reads.

nodes.name: Submit appliances
nodes.summary: Reads the ticked appliance kinds and notes.

nodes.name: Parse appliances
nodes.summary: Parses ticked kinds from the fixed list with their model notes.

nodes.name: Save appliances
nodes.summary: Stores the appliances map; a Plan may only prepare Recipes the User's appliances can cook.

nodes.name: Submit brief
nodes.summary: Reads the Planning Brief text.

nodes.name: Save brief
nodes.summary: Stores the Planning Brief, applying from the next planning Run.

nodes.name: Ingredients
nodes.summary: A User's own catalogue of foods with nutrition per 100 g, 100 ml or piece, a Unit and a usual Storage Location. It guards one Ingredient per food with name normalisation and fuzzy suggestions, and refuses edits or deletes that would break the Kitchen Ledger, a Recipe or a Plan.

businessRules: Each food is one Ingredient: plurals and size or grade words don't make a new one (normalised name unique per User)
A name close to an existing one is suggested before adding unless the User confirms
The unit is fixed once Movements or Recipes use it
An Ingredient with Movements, listed by a Recipe, or used by a Plan or Plan Proposal can't be deleted
Marking an Ingredient a Staple counts its Stock Items to nothing
crossDomainInteractions: Stock Items in the Kitchen Ledger are quantities of Ingredients
Recipes and planner Recipe Drafts add new Ingredients in their own transaction
Asks the planning feature (UsesIngredient) before deleting

nodes.name: Add Ingredient
nodes.summary: The User adds a food with its nutrition; a close existing name is suggested first, and a successful add continues into counting it in the kitchen.

nodes.name: Suggest on blur
nodes.summary: Shows the existing Ingredient a typed name probably meant, as the User leaves the field.

nodes.name: Submit add
nodes.summary: Parses the form, answers Problems or a suggestion, otherwise adds the Ingredient.

nodes.name: Check problems
nodes.summary: Validates name, unit, location and nutrition field by field.

nodes.name: Normalise name
nodes.summary: Builds the identity key ignoring case, plurals and size or grade words.

nodes.name: Find closest
nodes.summary: Finds the known Ingredient a mistyped name most likely meant (trigram similarity or one slip).

nodes.name: Save ingredient
nodes.summary: Adds it unless a close name needs confirming or the name is taken.

nodes.name: Continue to count
nodes.summary: Opens the Count of the new Ingredient so its stock can be recorded.

nodes.name: Edit Ingredient
nodes.summary: The User changes an Ingredient; the unit stays fixed once used, and making it a Staple counts its stock to nothing.

nodes.name: Submit edit
nodes.summary: Parses the edit form and answers refusals as field errors.

nodes.name: Save edit
nodes.summary: Refuses a unit change once Movements or Recipes use it, updates the row and counts a new Staple to nothing.

nodes.name: Count to nothing
nodes.summary: Writes Counts to zero for each Stock Item holding the Ingredient, under the kitchen lock.

nodes.name: Build counts
nodes.summary: Builds a zero Count Movement per Storage Location holding some.

nodes.name: Notify staple
nodes.summary: Tells the User which Stock Items were counted to nothing.

nodes.name: Delete Ingredient
nodes.summary: The User deletes an Ingredient after confirming; it is refused while Movements, a Recipe or a Plan or Plan Proposal refer to it.

nodes.name: Confirm delete
nodes.summary: Shows the confirm step, or why deleting is refused, as a sheet or page.

nodes.name: Submit delete
nodes.summary: Deletes and lands on the list, or explains which reference blocks it.

nodes.name: Retry on race
nodes.summary: Retries once when a reference appeared meanwhile, so a check names it instead of a foreign-key error.

nodes.name: Check movements
nodes.summary: Refuses when any Movement of the Kitchen Ledger refers to it.

nodes.name: Check recipes
nodes.summary: Refuses with the first Recipe listing it and how many others do.

nodes.name: Check plans
nodes.summary: Refuses when a Plan or any Plan Proposal sets it out or uses it.

nodes.name: Delete
nodes.summary: Deletes the row in the same transaction as the checks.

nodes.name: Search Ingredients
nodes.summary: The Ingredients page lists the User's foods, filtered live by a typo-tolerant search.

nodes.name: Show page
nodes.summary: Renders the Ingredients page.

nodes.name: Live list
nodes.summary: Returns the filtered list fragment as the User types.

nodes.name: Listing
nodes.summary: Finds matches and which have Movements (so their delete is refused).

nodes.name: Search names
nodes.summary: Ranks names by spelling similarity, most alike first.

nodes.name: Recipe Library
nodes.summary: The User's Recipes with their Ingredients, steps, Portions made, appliances and Slot kinds. Recipes are written by hand, parsed from pasted text by an LLM parse Run into a Recipe Draft to review, or drafted by the planner and accepted when its Plan Proposal is approved.

businessRules: No two of a User's Recipes share a name (normalised key)
Each Ingredient is listed once per Recipe; new Ingredients are added only once the User confirms their values
A pasted Recipe is translated into the User's Language when parsed
A Recipe a Plan or Plan Proposal prepares can't be deleted
Editing a Recipe never rechecks an approved Plan
crossDomainInteractions: Resolves and creates Ingredients in its own transaction
Parse Runs run on the Agent Runs engine
Plan Proposals' Recipe Drafts are accepted into the Library on approval

nodes.name: Write Recipe
nodes.summary: The User writes or edits a Recipe on a single form with dynamic Ingredient and step rows, creating any new Ingredient in the same transaction.

nodes.name: Show form
nodes.summary: Renders an empty Recipe form.

nodes.name: Ingredient row
nodes.summary: Returns an Ingredient row resolved against known Ingredients, with fields for a new one.

nodes.name: Save form
nodes.summary: Reads the posted rows and steps, answers Problems or refusals, then adds or edits.

nodes.name: Validate
nodes.summary: Checks name, minutes, Portions, appliances and each Ingredient row field by field.

nodes.name: Add recipe
nodes.summary: Adds the Recipe, refusing a taken name.

nodes.name: Save ingredients
nodes.summary: Saves its Ingredient rows, adding new Ingredients first.

nodes.name: Edit recipe
nodes.summary: Replaces an existing Recipe and its rows.

nodes.name: Parse Pasted Recipe
nodes.summary: The User pastes recipe text; a parse Run asks the model to submit it as a Recipe in the User's Language, and leaves a Recipe Draft to review.

nodes.name: Paste
nodes.summary: Reads the pasted text and lands on the parse Run's live Trace.

nodes.name: Start parse
nodes.summary: Starts a parse Run for the signed-in User.

nodes.name: Parse brief
nodes.summary: Builds the parse Brief: system prompt and the submit_recipe tool.

nodes.name: Start run
nodes.summary: Records the Run and carries it out in the background.

nodes.name: To recipe
nodes.summary: Reads submit_recipe input into a Recipe, resolving Ingredients and feeding Problems back to the model.

nodes.name: Link draft
nodes.summary: A succeeded parse Run's page links to the Recipe Draft it left.

nodes.name: Review Recipe Draft
nodes.summary: The User opens a parsed Recipe Draft on the Recipe form, edits it, and accepts it into the Library or discards it.

nodes.name: Show draft
nodes.summary: Renders the Recipe Draft on the Recipe form.

nodes.name: Find draft
nodes.summary: Loads the Recipe Draft and resolves its Ingredients against known ones.

nodes.name: Accept
nodes.summary: Posts the edited form to accept the draft.

nodes.name: Accept draft
nodes.summary: Adds the Recipe and deletes the draft in one transaction.

nodes.name: Discard
nodes.summary: Posts the discard after confirming.

nodes.name: Discard draft
nodes.summary: Deletes the Recipe Draft.

nodes.name: Browse and Delete Recipes
nodes.summary: The User searches the Library, views a Recipe, and deletes one unless a Plan or Plan Proposal prepares it.

nodes.name: Library
nodes.summary: Renders the Recipe Library and pending Recipe Drafts.

nodes.name: Search
nodes.summary: Finds Recipes by name.

nodes.name: Show
nodes.summary: Renders one Recipe with per-Portion nutrition.

nodes.name: Confirm removal
nodes.summary: Asks before deleting, as a sheet or page.

nodes.name: Submit delete
nodes.summary: Deletes and lands on the Library, or says a Plan prepares it.

nodes.name: Delete
nodes.summary: Deletes the Recipe, rolling back with ErrInPlan when a Plan or Plan Proposal prepares it.

nodes.name: Check prepared
nodes.summary: Reports whether any Prep Session of a Plan Proposal prepares the Recipe.

nodes.name: Kitchen Ledger
nodes.summary: What the kitchen holds is never stored: it is what the append-only Kitchen Ledger of Movements adds up to at a moment (ADR-0013). Users record Counts, moves between pantry, fridge and freezer, and added Portions; every write goes through one locked path, and a scheduler beat brings each kitchen up to now.

businessRules: Stock is the sum of Movements; quantities are exact tenths and never below nothing
Every write holds the User's kitchen row lock (ledger.Service.Write)
A move is a single ledger event and can't move more than is held
A Portion's location and presence derive from its Movements
Bringing a kitchen up to now is idempotent for a moment already reached
crossDomainInteractions: Ingredients define what Stock Items are
Plan Proposals read stock, frozen Portions and Portions without a Slot for the planner and the thaw rule
Today reads the last beat to say how fresh the kitchen is

nodes.name: View Kitchen
nodes.summary: The Kitchen page shows Stock Items and Portion Lots by Storage Location as the ledger adds up at now, with each one's Movements on demand.

nodes.name: Up to now
nodes.summary: Middleware bringing the User's kitchen up to now before each page.

nodes.name: Show
nodes.summary: Renders the Kitchen page.

nodes.name: Contents
nodes.summary: Loads Movements and Portions and adds them up at now.

nodes.name: Fold ledger
nodes.summary: Replays Movements to the Stock Items held at a moment.

nodes.name: Group lots
nodes.summary: Groups alike Portions into Lots by Storage Location and name.

nodes.name: Movements
nodes.summary: A Stock Item's Movements, newest first, answering why it holds what it does.

nodes.name: Count Stock Item
nodes.summary: The User states what a Storage Location holds of an Ingredient; the Count writes the difference as a Movement.

nodes.name: Start count
nodes.summary: Builds the Count form with the Ingredient's current holding.

nodes.name: Countable
nodes.summary: Lists Ingredients to count, Staples left out.

nodes.name: Submit count
nodes.summary: Reads the stated quantity and answers field errors or the recorded change.

nodes.name: Parse count
nodes.summary: Parses the stated quantity in the Ingredient's unit.

nodes.name: Record count
nodes.summary: Records the Count at now through the ledger write path.

nodes.name: Write ledger
nodes.summary: Holds the kitchen, replays the ledger and appends the Movement.

nodes.name: Build movement
nodes.summary: Builds the Count Movement: stated minus held.

nodes.name: Move Stock Item
nodes.summary: The User moves some of an Ingredient between pantry, fridge and freezer as one ledger event.

nodes.name: Start move
nodes.summary: Builds the move form with what each location holds.

nodes.name: Submit move
nodes.summary: Reads the move and answers errors or the recorded move.

nodes.name: Parse move
nodes.summary: Parses the moved quantity and checks the locations differ.

nodes.name: Record move
nodes.summary: Records the move at now under the kitchen lock.

nodes.name: Check move
nodes.summary: Refuses moving more than is held.

nodes.name: Write ledger
nodes.summary: Appends the move Movement.

nodes.name: Add Portions
nodes.summary: The User records ready-to-eat Portions (with per-Portion nutrition) placed in a Storage Location.

nodes.name: Submit portions
nodes.summary: Reads the Add Portions sheet.

nodes.name: Parse portions
nodes.summary: Parses name, how many, location and nutrition.

nodes.name: Record portions
nodes.summary: Saves the Portions and their Movement in one locked transaction.

nodes.name: Save portions
nodes.summary: Saves the Portion rows and returns their ids.

nodes.name: Build movement
nodes.summary: Builds the Movement placing the new Portions.

nodes.name: Write ledger
nodes.summary: Appends the Movement with its Portions.

nodes.name: Count or Move Portion Lot
nodes.summary: The User counts a Portion Lot or moves some of it to another Storage Location (e.g. freezer to fridge).

nodes.name: Start lot form
nodes.summary: Loads the Lot named in the query and builds its form.

nodes.name: Submit count
nodes.summary: Reads the Lot Count.

nodes.name: Parse lot count
nodes.summary: Parses a whole number of Portions.

nodes.name: Submit move
nodes.summary: Reads the Lot move.

nodes.name: Write lot
nodes.summary: Holds the kitchen, reloads the Lot and writes its Movement.

nodes.name: Build count
nodes.summary: Removes the Portions a lower Count says are gone, oldest first.

nodes.name: Build move
nodes.summary: Moves some Portions of the Lot to another location.

nodes.name: Check fits
nodes.summary: Refuses a count or move beyond the Lot's size.

nodes.name: Scheduler Beat
nodes.summary: On a fixed interval the app brings every User's kitchen up to now and records the beat Today reports.

nodes.name: Schedule
nodes.summary: Starts the beat loop on the clock.

nodes.name: Tick
nodes.summary: Calls the beat every interval; the Manual clock beats deterministically in tests.

nodes.name: Beat
nodes.summary: Brings each User's kitchen up to the beat and records it, as that User.

nodes.name: Up to now
nodes.summary: The same step every request runs for the signed-in User.

nodes.name: Cycle Planning & Today
nodes.summary: Cycles are the stretch one supermarket Delivery must last; the User opens an upcoming one, drops it, and follows on the Cycle page how planning it stands. Today, the landing page, shows the current or next Slot, the later ones, kitchen freshness and when a Cycle can be opened.

businessRules: Cycles never overlap and at most one is upcoming
A Cycle is upcoming until its Delivery arrives (end of its window), current until the next arrives, then closed; status is computed, never stored
Opening a Cycle is refused without Targets or while one is upcoming
Dropping an upcoming Cycle deletes its Plan Proposals and cancels its planning Run
A Slot belongs to the upcoming Cycle only after its Delivery window ends
crossDomainInteractions: Opening a Cycle lands on the Kitchen Check that starts Plan Proposals' planning Run
The Cycle page shows Plan Proposals, the approved Plan and the latest planning Run
Today reads Slot times from Profile & Goals and the last beat from the Kitchen Ledger

nodes.name: Open Cycle
nodes.summary: The User types a Delivery date, window and end date to open the upcoming Cycle, then lands on its Kitchen Check.

nodes.name: Show open
nodes.summary: Renders the open form, saying upfront why opening would be refused.

nodes.name: Refusal
nodes.summary: ErrNoTargets without Targets, ErrUpcoming while a Cycle is upcoming.

nodes.name: Submit open
nodes.summary: Opens the posted Cycle and lands on its Kitchen Check, or re-renders with errors.

nodes.name: Parse cycle
nodes.summary: Parses Delivery date, window and end date in the Language's day order, per field.

nodes.name: Open
nodes.summary: Checks the refusal and saves the Cycle in one transaction.

nodes.name: Drop Cycle
nodes.summary: The User drops the upcoming Cycle; its Plan Proposals go with it and its planning Run is cancelled.

nodes.name: Confirm drop
nodes.summary: Asks before dropping, as a sheet or page.

nodes.name: Submit drop
nodes.summary: Drops and lands on the Cycle page.

nodes.name: Drop
nodes.summary: Deletes the upcoming Cycle with its Plan Proposals and stops its planning Run after commit.

nodes.name: Find upcoming
nodes.summary: Refuses a Cycle no longer upcoming.

nodes.name: End run
nodes.summary: Cancels the Cycle's going planning Run in the same transaction.

nodes.name: View Cycle
nodes.summary: The Cycle page shows the current and upcoming Cycles and how planning each stands: pending Plan Proposal, approved Plan, its days against the Targets, freezer splits and the latest planning Run.

nodes.name: Show
nodes.summary: Renders the Cycle page with any refusal and the Planning Note still typed.

nodes.name: Now
nodes.summary: Loads the current and upcoming Cycles at now.

nodes.name: Statuses
nodes.summary: Computes each Cycle's status from its Delivery.

nodes.name: Planning of
nodes.summary: Gathers pending and approved Proposals, the last Run, the Library and the trailing days.

nodes.name: Load plan
nodes.summary: Reads a Proposal's Prep Sessions, kept Portions and freezer splits.

nodes.name: Eaten by
nodes.summary: What approved Plans put in each Slot, for the days shown against the Targets.

nodes.name: Resolve
nodes.summary: Resolves a stored Proposal's Recipes, Ingredients, Portions and Recipe Drafts by id.

nodes.name: Show Today
nodes.summary: The landing page shows the current or next Slot first, the later ones, how fresh the kitchen is, and set-up links before a Plan exists.

nodes.name: Show
nodes.summary: Renders Today at the clock's now.

nodes.name: At
nodes.summary: Assembles what Today shows at a moment.

nodes.name: Slot times
nodes.summary: Reads the Profile's Slot times.

nodes.name: Last beat
nodes.summary: When the scheduler last brought the kitchen up to now.

nodes.name: Cycles now
nodes.summary: Whether a Cycle is current or upcoming, deciding the open-a-Cycle prompt.

nodes.name: Today slots
nodes.summary: Picks the now-or-next Slot and the later ones of the day.

nodes.name: Plan Proposals
nodes.summary: A planning Run turns a Cycle into a Plan Proposal: the planner model drafts Prep Sessions, Portions, freezer splits and new Recipe Drafts, checks them against hard rules (Slots, Recipe fit, thawing) and soft rules (Targets, leftovers) with its tools, and submits one. The User approves it, which accepts its Recipe Drafts into the Library, or rejects it with a Planning Note that starts another Run.

businessRules: At most one Plan Proposal pending or one planning Run going at a time across all Cycles (advisory lock in turn)
A submitted draft must keep every hard rule; after a fixed number of rule-breaking submits the Run fails
Frozen food needs an evening left to thaw before its Slot or Prep Session (NoEveningToThaw)
A Prep Session of a Recipe must fit the Slot kinds and the User's appliances (RecipesUnfit)
Missing a Target is a soft miss shown on the Proposal, never a refusal; the Proposal keeps the Targets it aimed at
A Proposal whose first Slot has passed can't be approved
Rejecting with a Planning Note starts a new Run from the rejected Proposal's first Slot; planning again without the Kitchen Check needs a failed last Run
crossDomainInteractions: Runs on the Agent Runs engine with check_plan, submit_plan and draft_recipe tools
Reads Profile & Goals (Targets, Brief, appliances, foods), the Recipe Library, Ingredients and Kitchen Ledger stock
Approval adds the Proposal's Recipe Drafts, and their new Ingredients, to the Recipe Library
Blocks deleting Ingredients and Recipes its Plans use

nodes.name: Plan Cycle
nodes.summary: After the Kitchen Check the User starts planning; the service gathers Profile, Library, kitchen and earlier Plans into the planner prompt, takes its turn under the planning lock and starts a planning Run.

nodes.name: Kitchen check
nodes.summary: Shows the Kitchen Check of the upcoming Cycle so the User corrects stock before planning.

nodes.name: Confirm plan
nodes.summary: Confirms the Kitchen Check, starts the Run and lands on its live Trace.

nodes.name: Start planning
nodes.summary: Starts planning a Cycle from its first Slot.

nodes.name: Gather inputs
nodes.summary: Reads Profile, Planning Brief, Notes, Library, Ingredients, kitchen Contents and approved Plans, builds the planBrief and starts the Run.

nodes.name: List slots
nodes.summary: The Cycle's Slots from the first after its Delivery to its end date.

nodes.name: Build prompt
nodes.summary: Writes the planner prompt: Slots, Targets, trailing days, foods, appliances, Brief, Notes, Library and kitchen.

nodes.name: Take turn
nodes.summary: Under the planning advisory lock refuses a Cycle with a Plan or while another Run or Proposal is in flight.

nodes.name: Start run
nodes.summary: Records the planning Run and carries it out in the background.

nodes.name: Check and Submit Draft Plan
nodes.summary: Inside the planning Run the model calls check_plan on whole draft Plans, reading back hard-rule violations, each day's nutrition against the Targets and soft misses, then submit_plan stores the chosen draft as the pending Plan Proposal.

domainMeta.entryPoint: check_plan / submit_plan tool calls in a planning Run

nodes.name: Check plan
nodes.summary: Spends one of the check_plan budget, reads the draft and lists every hard rule it breaks with its results.

nodes.name: Read draft
nodes.summary: Resolves Recipe, Ingredient, Portion and Recipe Draft ids, Slots and freezer splits, or lists why it can't be read.

nodes.name: Hard rules
nodes.summary: Slots each filled once, Portions within size and Slot, unslotted Portions used first; RecipesUnfit adds Slot-kind and appliance fit.

nodes.name: Thaw rule
nodes.summary: Frozen Portions and frozen stock a Prep Session needs must have an evening left to thaw, from Thaws of the plan against kitchen stock.

nodes.name: Judge targets
nodes.summary: Each planned day and the average over whole days against the Targets, the soft misses and Portions made for after the Cycle.

nodes.name: Soft misses
nodes.summary: Portions of one Prep Session eaten too close together and kept Portions left unused.

nodes.name: Submit plan
nodes.summary: Chooses a checked draft that keeps every hard rule, or fails the Run after too many that don't.

nodes.name: Store proposal
nodes.summary: As the Run succeeds, stores the pending Proposal with Prep Sessions, Portions, freezer splits, Recipe Drafts, Targets and misses.

nodes.name: Draft Recipe for Plan
nodes.summary: The planner drafts new Recipes with draft_recipe and prepares them by negative ids in its Plan; the User can read each draft from the pending Proposal.

domainMeta.entryPoint: draft_recipe tool call in a planning Run; GET /plan/drafts/{id}

nodes.name: Draft tool
nodes.summary: Reads the draft_recipe input, replacing a draft of the same name, and gives its negative id.

nodes.name: Read draft
nodes.summary: Reads the drafted Recipe against known Ingredients and the Library, refusing clashing names.

nodes.name: Fix these
nodes.summary: Turns the Recipe's Problems into lines the model must fix.

nodes.name: Save draft
nodes.summary: Stores the Recipe Draft as owned by its Plan Proposal.

nodes.name: Drafted
nodes.summary: Loads a Recipe Draft of the pending Proposal in the User's Language.

nodes.name: Show draft
nodes.summary: Shows the Recipe Draft as a sheet or page from the Proposal.

nodes.name: Approve Plan Proposal
nodes.summary: The User approves the pending Plan Proposal; it becomes the Cycle's Plan, and its Recipe Drafts become Recipes in the Library, unless its first Slot has passed or a draft now clashes.

nodes.name: Submit approve
nodes.summary: Approves and lands on the Cycle page, or shows which rule refused.

nodes.name: Approve
nodes.summary: Runs the approval in one transaction.

nodes.name: Pending proposal
nodes.summary: Finds the pending Proposal's Cycle and first Slot, else ErrNoProposal.

nodes.name: Starts in past
nodes.summary: Refuses a Proposal whose first Slot has passed (BlocksApproval).

nodes.name: Read drafts
nodes.summary: Reads back the Proposal's stored Recipe Drafts.

nodes.name: Accept drafted
nodes.summary: Adds each draft and its new Ingredients to the Library, or a ClashError.

nodes.name: Prepare accepted
nodes.summary: Points Prep Sessions from the draft to the new Recipe.

nodes.name: Decide
nodes.summary: Marks the Proposal approved at now.

nodes.name: Reject or Plan Again
nodes.summary: The User rejects the pending Proposal, optionally with a Planning Note that starts a new planning Run; after a failed Run they can plan again without the Kitchen Check.

nodes.name: Submit reject
nodes.summary: Rejects; with a Planning Note lands on the new Run.

nodes.name: Reject
nodes.summary: Without a note only rejects; with one, starts a Run from the Proposal's first Slot.

nodes.name: Decide rejected
nodes.summary: Marks the Proposal rejected in the new Run's transaction.

nodes.name: Save note
nodes.summary: Keeps the Planning Note on the Cycle, tied to the rejected Proposal.

nodes.name: Submit again
nodes.summary: Starts another Run with any posted note.

nodes.name: Plan again
nodes.summary: Allowed only when the Cycle's last planning Run failed, from that Run's first Slot.

nodes.name: Restart run
nodes.summary: Starts the planning Run with the note, committing it together.

nodes.name: Refused
nodes.summary: 404 when nothing to decide, or the Cycle page saying which rule refused it.

nodes.name: Agent Runs
nodes.summary: Every LLM job is a Run carried out in the background as its User by the runs Engine over a hand-written tool-use loop (ADR-0003). Each Run records a Trace of events that pages stream live, can be cancelled, and is marked failed if Dandori stopped while it was going.

businessRules: Cancelling a Run rolls nothing back; a cancelled planning Run produces no Plan Proposal
A Run still going when Dandori stops counts as failed, not cancelled
Retryable model failures back off exponentially; turns are bounded
Tool errors go back to the model unless fatal (agent.Failure)
crossDomainInteractions: Parse Runs serve the Recipe Library; planning Runs serve Plan Proposals
Each feature describes its own Runs' pages (RunPage)

nodes.name: Carry Out Run
nodes.summary: A feature starts a Run; the Engine records it and, in the background, drives the tool-use loop, tracing each model call as a span and each event to the Trace.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Engine.Start called by a feature (parse or planning Run)

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Records the Run in the caller's transaction and launches it after commit.

nodes.name: Execute
nodes.summary: Runs it as its User, handles cancellation and stores the final status.

nodes.name: Carry out
nodes.summary: Hands the Brief to the agent Loop with the Trace sink.

nodes.name: Loop
nodes.summary: Asks the model, runs requested tools and maps stop reasons to an outcome.

nodes.name: Send
nodes.summary: Retries retryable failures with doubling backoff.

nodes.name: Traced call
nodes.summary: Wraps each model call in a gen-AI OpenTelemetry span.

nodes.name: Run tools
nodes.summary: Runs tool calls in order, returning errors to the model unless fatal.

nodes.name: Emit
nodes.summary: Stores each Trace Event and fans it out to followers.

nodes.name: Follow Run
nodes.summary: The Run page shows its Trace and streams new events over server-sent events while it goes.

nodes.name: Show
nodes.summary: Renders the Run with its Trace and feature-specific links.

nodes.name: Find
nodes.summary: Loads the signed-in User's Run.

nodes.name: Stream
nodes.summary: Streams new Trace Events as SSE until the Run ends.

nodes.name: Trace after
nodes.summary: Events after the last one the page has.

nodes.name: Follow
nodes.summary: Subscribes to live events of a going Run.

nodes.name: Write SSE
nodes.summary: Writes one rendered event.

nodes.name: Cancel Run
nodes.summary: The User, or something that ends a planning Run (a dropped Cycle), cancels a going Run.

nodes.name: Submit cancel
nodes.summary: Cancels and returns to the Run page.

nodes.name: Cancel
nodes.summary: Marks the Run cancelled and stops its goroutine.

nodes.name: Cancel in
nodes.summary: Cancels inside a caller's transaction, stopping it only after commit.

nodes.name: List Runs
nodes.summary: The Runs page lists the User's Runs with status and age, each linking where its kind says.

nodes.name: List
nodes.summary: Renders the Runs list.

nodes.name: Engine list
nodes.summary: Loads the User's Runs, newest first.

nodes.name: Parse page
nodes.summary: A parse Run links to its Recipe Draft.

nodes.name: Planning page
nodes.summary: A planning Run links to its Cycle page.

nodes.name: Recover Runs at Start
nodes.summary: When Dandori starts, Runs left going by a crash or deploy are marked failed.

nodes.name: Serve
nodes.summary: Builds the app and serves HTTP until stopped.

nodes.name: Build app
nodes.summary: Opens and migrates the database and wires every Service and the Engine.

nodes.name: Fail left going
nodes.summary: Marks Runs still going as failed.

edges.description: The signed-in User passes to the LanguageChosen middleware, which serves pages in their Language or sends them to choose one
The planner prompt reads Targets, foods, appliances and the Planning Brief; a Plan Proposal snapshots the Targets it aimed at
Opening a Cycle needs Targets; Today places Slots by the Profile's Slot times
Stock Items are quantities of Ingredients; marking a Staple counts its stock to nothing; Ingredients with Movements can't be deleted
Recipes resolve and add Ingredients in their transaction; an Ingredient a Recipe lists can't be deleted
Pasted text starts a parse Run whose submit_recipe tool leaves a Recipe Draft
Opening a Cycle leads to its Kitchen Check and planning Run; the Cycle page shows Proposals and the Plan; dropping a Cycle deletes its Proposals and cancels its Run
Today reads the last scheduler beat to say how fresh the kitchen is
Planning starts a planning Run with check_plan, submit_plan and draft_recipe tools; dropping a Cycle cancels it
The planner reads stock, Portions without a Slot and frozen Portions; the thaw rule and freezer splits work on Storage Locations
The planner reads the Library and drafts Recipes, accepted into it on approval; a Recipe a Plan prepares can't be deleted
Drafted Recipes add new Ingredients on approval; an Ingredient a Plan or Proposal uses can't be deleted
